public.description: The card's public details: a complete cards.sunshine.card record, published when someone first collects the card.

adminKey.description: The tag's key 0, needed to change its settings or keys.

signingKey.description: The key the tag signs taps with. It also decrypts the tag's PICC data.

allowRescans.description: Whether one person may collect this card more than once.

main.description: A card's secrets, kept in its creator's deck. The record key is the card's UID, as 14 upper-case hex characters.
